cases.reason: 2002 says the lock is set as part of the ATOMIC operation of the I-O statement; 2023 dropped 'atomic'. The 2023 row (no witness aimed at GR8; l1c17_lock_mode_no_other_inert) shows the lock is set inside the verb, not that check, read and lock are indivisible against other run units. Code read: keyed connectors run each governed statement inside KeyedConnector.BeginStatement's cross-run-unit store mutex (atomic); the sequential connector's BeginStatement is inert (FileConnector.cs:932), and FileRegistry.ReadSharedInStatement checks conflicts before the read and calls LockRecord after it, so atomicity for a shared sequential file depends on PhysicalFileTable.LockRecord/RegionLocks, which I did not read.
cases.needs: a signed derivation or a two-run-unit race witness that a sequential file's READ conflict check, read and LockRecord are indivisible (PhysicalFileTable.LockRecord with RegionLocks); keyed organizations rest on the store mutex
cases.compiler-at-2002: not probed: atomicity needs two concurrent run units, which a three-line program cannot show
